blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Government intelligence teams need LLM agents that can analyze large, messy evidence collections, but security and cost constraints often rule out hosted frontier models and broad, hard-to-audit tool surfaces. We report CLEO: Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization, a method for fitting a minimal agent harness to a fixed, self-hostable LLM. Given an expert-validated dataset, CLEO admits only the tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components that improve accuracy while remaining general and auditable. On our held-out dataset, the CLEO harness reaches an 83.8% pass rate, within 1.2 points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline, while being two orders of magnitude smaller.
blocks.zh: 政府情报组需要LLM特工,能够分析大量,杂乱的证据收集,但安全和费用方面的限制往往排除了托管的前沿模型和广泛的,难以审计的工具表面. 我们报告CLEO: 限制环环环境优化,一种将最小的干线绳接入固定的,可自我接受的LLM的方法。 鉴于一个经过专家验证的数据集,CLEO只承认工具、护栏、内存政策和循环组件,它们既能提高准确性,又能保持总体性和可审计性。 在我们的被搁置的数据集上,CLEO的牵引力达到了83.8%的通过率,在最强的外框Claude Code SDK基线的1.2分之内,同时是两个规模更小的级.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en:
Analysts in government organizations investigate complex cases spanning
thousands of heterogeneous documents—emails, reports, call records,
spreadsheets, chat logs, and multilingual material with inconsistent or unknown
schemas—revisiting them repeatedly to aggregate evidence, reconcile
contradictions, trace entities, and build coherent explanations.
blocks.zh:
政府组织的分析员调查复杂的案件
数千种不同的文件——电子邮件、报告、电话记录、
电子表格、聊天日志和不一致或未知的多语种材料
计划——反复重审,以收集证据,调节
矛盾 追踪实体 建立连贯的解释

blocks.en:
LLM agents can make such investigations tractable, but only through a harness : the tools, memory, execution policies, and control loop
that let the model search corpora, inspect files, run analyses, and
refine hypotheses. In high-security settings both the served model and the harness are
constrained: data sensitivity and cost push organizations toward smaller
self-hostable models, while security review forces tight control over exposed
capabilities—every new tool and every line of harness code must be inspected,
justified, and often certified before deployment.

blocks.en:
Two lines of work bear on this. Harness design spans
reason-and-act control ( 1 ) , filesystem agent–computer
interfaces ( 2 ) , lean and generic-purpose harness implementations such as
PI ( 7 ) . Harness optimization automates this design, from agent-design search ( 3 ) to
autoresearch-like loops ( 4 ) and
observability-driven harness evolution ( 10 ) . Evidence access is a further design choice: where the dominant pattern
pre-indexes the corpus into embeddings ( 8 ) , indexless access through raw-file search and scripts can match or
beat strong retrievers on evolving, heterogeneous corpora ( 9 ) .

blocks.en:
We report CLEO , a method that enabled us to launch a deployed investigative agent around a fixed, self-hostable model and a deliberately
minimal harness. We use CLEO for both the optimization method and the resulting production harness. CLEO’s first contribution is an explicit justification gate : proposed harness changes must improve
accuracy and also be generic, auditable, and worth the added capability
surface. This realizes the multi-objective harness that was mentioned but not studied in ( 3 ) . Its second contribution is bottom-up harness
construction : the harness starts nearly empty and grows only when
evaluation shows that a new tool, guardrail, memory policy, or loop
component is necessary. Minimality is therefore optimized by construction,
not patched in later. The resulting agent holds up on held-out,
out-of-distribution cases (Table 1 ), is small enough for
security review, and is currently being deployed in client environments.

blocks.en: 2. Method
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 方法

blocks.en:
Datasets. Intelligence analysts work across distinct use cases ,
each a self-contained investigation with its own documents and questions; the
product must serve many, so we build and evaluate on three. Within a use case,
files are grouped into corpora —ingestion, classification,
investigation, insights, reporting, and multilingual content—that overlap in
their documents but differ in which files are relevant to a given query. A
representative use case holds about 8,000 files across up to seven formats,
with corpora from roughly 250 MB to 6 GB, and includes misleading and
contradictory evidence to stress robustness. Across the three use cases we
author 300+ expert questions at four difficulty levels; 240 are held out for evaluation and the rest
form the optimization pool.

blocks.en: 2.1. Model, Data, and a Minimal Harness
blocks.zh: 2.1. 模型、数据和最小功率

blocks.en:
The model. We work with self-hostable (on-premises), open-weights LLMs and treat the model as fixed : the method optimizes everything around it.
We report results with GLM-5.1 ( 5 ) .

blocks.en:
Optimization-loop dataset. The optimization loop runs on a single use case of four corpora, approximately
3,000 files in total. Each iteration evaluates the harness on 44 Q&A pairs:
a fixed core of 32—eight per corpus, drawn from all difficulty levels—plus
12 sampled fresh from the development pool every iteration. We keep the evaluation set small so each optimization iteration finishes within minutes, staying inside our time and compute budget. Periodically
the pool is swapped for an out-of-distribution development case. The final
240-question benchmark in Table 1 is held out and never exposed
to the supervisor loop.

blocks.en: A minimal harness. The initial agent is a ReAct-style model-in-a-loop ( 1 ) with a short list of terminal tools— ls , read , grep , a sandboxed non-persistent Python—and nothing else. CLEO builds on this minimal, file-system-native toolset, adding only the persistent per-case memory an analyst workflow needs.
blocks.zh: 最小的吊带。 最初的代理是ReAct风格的型号-in-a-loop (1),其中包含一个终端工具的短列表—— Is, read, grep, 一个沙盒非持久性的Python—— 其它的没有. CLEO基于这个最小的,文件系统本土化的工具集,只增加了一个分析师工作流程需要的持续的每件内存.

blocks.en: 2.2. The optimization loop
blocks.zh: 2.2. 优化循环

blocks.en:
Inspired by autoresearch ( 4 ) , a supervisor model (a frontier LLM - we chose Opus-4.8 ( 12 ) ) drives an automatic
propose–test–keep loop over harness versions
(Algorithm 1 ). A proposed change is kept only if it improves the current evaluation objective a a —the pass-rate/soft-score summary produced by Eval —by a margin ϵ \epsilon on the current graded subset D t D_{t} and survives our key contribution: a justification check that asks whether the edit is generic, auditable, and as lean as possible. This second gate is meant to guard against both
benchmark overfitting and scaffold bloat. Accepted changes define the
final harness: a small set of tools plus tuned guardrails,
retry/refusal handling, context compaction, memory policy, and tool-call
budgets. They trigger an error analysis that drives the
next proposal. To prevent the loop from fitting a single case, the evaluation set is periodically swapped for an out-of-distribution pool. Eval runs the candidate on 32 fixed and 12 randomly drawn Q&A and scores each cited answer with an LLM judge ( 6 ) against expert ground truth.
We optimize bottom-up rather than pruning a large off-the-shelf harness: in a
broad harness much must be removed, and deciding which capabilities are
unnecessary is itself a slow security and engineering exercise. In our
experiments, top-down optimization matched bottom-up on accuracy but barely
shrank the harness, whereas the near-empty CLEO loop added only what it
needed—e.g., read/write memory tools and a non-answer safety net with a
retry loop. Conversely, a cite() helper, proposed after error
analysis showed the judge penalizing answers with missing evidence, was
reverted: the agent rarely used it, so the change failed the justification
gate.

blocks.en: 3. Results
blocks.zh: 3个 结果

blocks.en:
We evaluate four agent harnesses on our intelligence analysis benchmarks,
holding fixed the model (GLM-5.1 ( 5 ) ), and a single Claude Opus 4.8 LLM judge ( 12 , 6 ) . The judge receives the candidate answer and expert ground truth, then returns a correct/incorrect verdict and a 0–10 soft score.
blocks.zh:
我们评价四个特工利用我们的情报分析基准
持有固定型号(GLM-5.1(5)),以及一名Claude Opus 4.8 LLM法官(12,6). 法官收到候选人的回答和专家的真相,然后返回正确/不正确的裁决和0-10的软分。

blocks.en:
We evaluate three baselines spanning two design axes: harness size (a large
off-the-shelf harness vs. a lightweight one) and prompt (generic vs. CLEO-optimized), reporting accuracy, latency, and estimated harness size for
each. The large harness is the Claude Code SDK ( 11 ) , a mature
production-grade system we treat as a reference point for what a
general-purpose harness achieves out of the box, paired with a generic
task-context prompt generated by Claude itself. The lightweight harness is
PI ( 7 ) , a minimal execution loop with no domain-specific prompting—the
natural comparison for CLEO, though still considerably larger. PI #1 receives
the same prompt as Claude; PI #2 receives CLEO’s full optimized prompt.

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that CLEO, despite its tiny harness, is
competitive with the substantially larger Claude Code SDK: an 83.8% pass rate
and 8.41/10 soft score, within 1.2 percentage points and 0.07 soft-score points
of the best baseline. On 240 held-out questions that gap is roughly three
questions, so we read this as practical parity rather than a ranking. CLEO also
matches or outperforms both PI versions on pass rate with a much smaller harness
surface and similar latency. Given the small accuracy gap against the large LOC gap, CLEO is the best trade-off. The bottom-up
direction matters: we ran a top-down loop from PI, permitting all modifications and encouraging
removals, yet it matched bottom-up on accuracy while barely shrinking the harness.

问题,所以我们把它看成是实际的对等而不是排名. CLEO还

表面和类似的潜伏。 鉴于准确性差距小,而当地办事处费用差距大,CLEO是最好的权衡。 从下往上

blocks.en: 4. Conclusions
blocks.zh: 4. 结论

blocks.en:
This work shows that ground-up harness optimization is a practical direction for deploying agentic
systems in regulated domains: a minimal harness approaches the accuracy of the
strongest out-of-the-box harness with two orders of magnitude less code and
capability surface. The result holds within a defined scope: a base model
already capable of multi-step tool use, one investigative domain, and accuracy
scored by an LLM judge that domain experts and product managers spot-checked but
that we did not validate systematically. Within those limits, careful harness
design is an effective systems optimization: exposing only task-essential
capabilities retains competitive performance while improving maintainability,
auditability, and operational simplicity for production deployments.
